reason: Fresh Product successor rooted directly at the ordinary #453 design/plan merge. Trusted main already has People-first Product composition, conversation-scoped RelationshipProjectionAuthority intelligence, Parlant goal/progress, Element conversation/navigation authority, and mature Base UI/Motion/Rive Product primitives. The remaining product gap is a Chinese real UI plus a truthful immersive People Home relationship constellation. This authorization keeps list as the default entry, adds an explicit user-centered universe presentation inside the existing exact-routed PeopleSurface, preserves all runtime authorities, and introduces no graph model, person-to-person edge authority, backend/IPC/data path, dependency, workflow, route bootstrap, or general-purpose Yance infrastructure.

requiredBehavior: People Home defaults to the existing list view and exposes relationship universe only through an explicit user action.
List and universe are peer presentations of the same RelationshipProjection array and switching views never selects or opens a person automatically.
The universe renders center 我 plus one outer relationship node and one uniform user-to-relationship spoke per existing RelationshipProjection; it never renders contact-to-contact edges.
Universe geometry is deterministic presentation only and is not derived from relationship intelligence, timestamps, message counts, scores or local heuristics.
Focusing a universe node updates only ephemeral focus and shows trusted relationship state/summary/next/evidence already present on that RelationshipProjection.
Entering Relationship World uses the existing selected-relationship path and returning restores the same People Home mode and last still-valid focus while the Product shell remains mounted.
Refresh clears stale focus without resetting the valid People Home mode; existing selected-relationship invalidation behavior remains intact.
Normal Product relationship chrome is Chinese according to the merged design spec while internal enum/runtime/authority identifiers remain stable.
Reduced-motion users receive static deterministic positions and Chinese visible AI state labels with all controls still usable.
Existing search/translation, Relationship World, Private Quest, relationship tools, overlays and settings keep their runtime behavior while their normal Product chrome is Chinese.
Relationship intelligence pending/empty/stale/unavailable states remain explicit and truthful; no missing trusted fact is fabricated.

Do not use relationshipPotential, customer_social_state, social_rule_projection, message_baseline, message counts, agent counts, Learning evidence or other legacy/runtime telemetry as relationship meaning.
